content: {"hypothesis": "The LLMNR traffic most likely comes from normal Windows name resolution on a VMware VM: the surrounding events are VMware ThinPrint (tpautoconnsvc.exe) writing printer driver files and being started by services.exe, which is expected benign behavior, so a cheap check of the parent services.exe process should be enough to confirm it is legitimate.", "attack_likelihood": 0.08, "choice": 2}
